aggregate_rendering.method: Equal-weight geometric mean of ratios of the eight median frame times; shaping excluded

new_regressions: All fixed-key hashes forced to collide; full key equality, stack ownership and clear/rebuild
Unhinted empty groups allocate no textures; first paint and empty Source semantics
Overlapping drawable groups across atlas pages, an intervening draw, a clip dependency and a nested layer: exact pixels with fewer encoded batches
validation.native_text_reference: Existing packed/unatlased Core Text pixel oracle; native hinting/AA and all interpolation modes retained
validation.background_load: User-authorized background load recorded. Other application basenames redacted in committed summary; full snapshots and distributions remain local.

macos_catalog.result: Every selected page captured through both render paths

published_path_policy: Checkout-relative paths and ~/ home placeholders; recorded measurements and artifact/source hashes are unchanged.
privacy_history_policy: Personal paths, background process names and local device identifiers are omitted. Source commit IDs from the superseded branch are redacted; content hashes and measurements are historical and predate the upstream rebase.
